study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Pinaya et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2019
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using deep autoencoders to identify abnormal brain structural patterns in neuropsychiatric disorders: A large-scale multi-sample study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Three public datasets: HCP; NUSDAST; ABIDE (ABIDE-I).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The data used in this study were obtained from three public data sets: Human Connectome Project (HCP) data set, Northwestern University Schizophrenia Data and Software Tool (NUSDAST) data set, and Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) data set."

answer.NUSDAST: clinical test dataset (HC + SCZ) for patient-control comparisons

answer.ABIDE-I: clinical test dataset (HC + ASD) for patient-control comparisons

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP healthy controls used to train the deep autoencoder; NUSDAST and ABIDE used as test datasets with patients and controls to compute deviation metrics and comparisons.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "First, we trained a model with morphometric data from healthy controls from a largescale data set: the Human Connectome Project (HCP; Van Essen et al., 2013)... After training this model, we used it to encode and reconstruct the data from two public data sets with psychiatry patients." "This resulted in 40 healthy controls and 35 patients with SCZ from the NUSDAST data set and 105 healthy controls and 83 subjects with ASD from the ABIDE data set."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative model trained using all 1,113 HCP healthy controls.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "In this study, we used sMRI data from 1,113 healthy controls taken from the '1200 Subjects Data Release (S1200 Release, March 2017)' which is part of the HCP data set." "The deep autoencoder was trained using all subjects from the HCP data set."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Pinaya2019.pdf.md: 2.2 | Subjects; Pinaya2019.pdf.md: 2.4 | Deep autoencoder training

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HCP age range noted as 22-37 years (used to match clinical datasets).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "From these two clinical data sets, we identified and selected those subjects within the same age range of the HCP data set (from 22 to 37 years old)."

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex counts for HCP healthy controls not reported; only notes that clinical datasets were balanced for age and sex.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "...the ABIDE data set ... composed of HC subjects and ASD patients balanced for age and sex."
